dialogues.speaker: Cat's Tail Message Board
dialogues.text: If you have anything to share, be it brooding or joyous, distressing or hilarious, write them down on our Message Board! Cat's Tail is all cat ears!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Even I sometimes reminisce about the carefree and happy days of the past. The warmth of the Knights, my friends, my father... Everything was perfect. But one can never return to the past."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "For the sake of the future, I cannot keep on dreaming in memories. Or should I say, someone has to wake up to face the darkness before dawn so that others may continue to dream."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Rationally, I know there are some things that one must let go of, yet emotionally this is much harder to do. Sometimes my heart is agonized by this..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Hope the business goes well. It's a battlefield out there in the liquor business."

dialogues.speaker: Cat's Tail's reply
dialogues.text: Life is like wine. It needs refinement and fermentation to mature.

dialogues.speaker: Cat's Tail's reply
dialogues.text: But the door of Cat's Tail is forever open to anyone, even to our business competitors! People can never return to their former lives, but they can always return to Cat's Tail to set their worries and sadness aside.
